articles.title: Gratitude Without Pretending Everything Is Fine
articles.titleHinglish: Shukraguzaari, Bina Yeh Dikhawa Kiye Ki Sab Theek Hai
articles.content:
Gratitude has been ruined for a lot of people by the way it is preached. Someone loses a job and is told to be grateful they have a family. Someone describes a genuine difficulty and is told others have it worse. That is not gratitude; it is a way of ending a conversation someone did not want to have.

Real gratitude does not require you to reclassify a bad thing as good. It sits alongside difficulty rather than replacing it. Today was hard and the food was good and my friend called. All three, at once, with no ranking.

Why bother, then? Because attention is selective and it defaults to threat. The mind is built to scan for what is wrong — an extremely useful design that produces a distorted daily summary in a life that is not actually under attack. Twelve things went fine today and one went badly, and the evening report contains only the last one. Gratitude is not positive thinking; it is a correction to a known bias in the instrument.

What makes it work, mechanically.

Be specific. I am grateful for my family is too broad to register. My brother sent a message at exactly the right time today is specific enough for the mind to actually feel something. Vague gratitude is a formality; specific gratitude is an experience.

Include ordinary things. Warm water. A working knee. A day without a phone call bringing bad news. Most of what holds a life together is invisible until it stops, and noticing it before it stops is the whole point.

Say it to a person. Written down in a journal it is useful. Said out loud to the person it is about, it does something much larger, and it costs a sentence. Tell someone specifically what they did and what it meant. Most people almost never hear this and remember it for years.

And keep it small and regular rather than large and occasional. Three lines at night. On the days you cannot find anything, write that too — today I could not find anything, which is honest and still counts.

One last thing, since this journal is built around a practice. The traditional teaching is that contentment is not what happens when you finally have enough; it is a decision made in the middle of not having enough. That sounds like resignation and it is not. You can be grateful for what today held and still be working hard to change tomorrow. Those have never been in conflict, whatever both the ambitious and the spiritual crowds tend to claim.
articles.contentHinglish:
Shukraguzaari ko bahut logon ke liye is baat ne kharab kar diya hai ki use kaise sikhaya jaata hai. Kisi ki job jaati hai to kehte hain shukar karo parivaar to hai. Koi asli mushkil batata hai to kehte hain doosron ka to aur bura haal hai. Wo shukraguzaari nahi hai; wo us baat-cheet ko band karne ka tareeka hai jo koi karna nahi chahta tha.

Asli shukraguzaari aapse yeh nahi maangti ki buri cheez ko achha keh do. Wo mushkil ke bagal mein baithti hai, uski jagah nahi leti. Aaj din bhaari tha aur khaana achha tha aur dost ka call aaya. Teeno, ek saath, bina kisi ranking ke.

Toh phir karein kyun? Kyunki dhyan chun kar chalta hai aur default mein khatre par jaata hai. Dimaag isi liye bana hai ki jo galat hai use dhoondhe — bahut kaam ka design, jo us zindagi mein galat daily summary banata hai jispar sach mein hamla nahi ho raha. Aaj barah cheezein theek gayi aur ek buri, aur shaam ki report mein sirf aakhri wali hai. Shukraguzaari positive thinking nahi hai; wo aupkaran mein maujood ek jaane-maane jhukav ka sudhaar hai.

Yeh mechanically kaam kaise karti hai.

Specific raho. "Main apne parivaar ke liye shukraguzaar hoon" itna chauda hai ki darj hi nahi hota. "Aaj bhai ne theek sahi waqt par message kiya" itna specific hai ki dimaag sach mein kuch mehsoos karta hai. Dhundhli shukraguzaari ek rasm hai; specific shukraguzaari ek anubhav.

Aam cheezein bhi shaamil karo. Garam paani. Chalta hua ghutna. Aisa din jisme koi buri khabar wala phone nahi aaya. Zindagi ko jodne wali zyadatar cheezein tab tak dikhti hi nahi jab tak wo ruk na jaayein, aur unke rukne se pehle unhe dekh lena hi poora maqsad hai.

Insaan ko bol kar kaho. Journal mein likhna kaam ka hai. Jis insaan ke baare mein hai use bol dena kahin bada kaam karta hai, aur kharcha ek sentence ka hai. Kisi ko specific batao ki unhone kya kiya aur uska kya matlab tha. Zyadatar log yeh lagbhag kabhi nahi sunte aur saalon yaad rakhte hain.

Aur ise chhota aur regular rakho, bada aur kabhi kabhi nahi. Raat ko teen line. Jis din kuch na mile, wo bhi likh do — aaj mujhe kuch nahi mila, jo imaandaar hai aur ginta bhi hai.

Ek aakhri baat, kyunki yeh journal ek practice par bana hai. Paramparik shiksha yeh hai ki santosh wo cheez nahi jo tab aati hai jab aakhirkaar kaafi ho jaata hai; wo kaafi na hone ke beech mein liya gaya faisla hai. Sunne mein haar lagti hai, hai nahi. Aap aaj jo mila uske liye shukraguzaar ho sakte ho aur kal badalne ke liye jee-jaan se kaam bhi kar sakte ho. Yeh dono kabhi ek doosre ke khilaf the hi nahi, chahe mehnat wale aur aadhyatm wale dono khemé kuch bhi kehte rahein.

articles.title: Enough Is a Decision, Not an Amount
articles.titleHinglish: "Bas, Itna Kaafi Hai" Ek Faisla Hai, Koi Raqam Nahi
articles.content:
Ask anyone what would be enough and you will get a number. Then wait a few years until they have it, and ask again. The number has moved, and it will keep moving, because the mechanism is not about the number at all.

The technical name is hedonic adaptation, and it is simply that humans normalise. Whatever you get becomes the new baseline within a few months — the salary, the house, the phone, the promotion. The pleasure of arriving is real, and it is temporary, and the reference point resets. Then the gap between where you are and what would be enough is exactly as wide as before.

This is not an argument against wanting things. It is an argument for noticing that the strategy of getting more, on its own, has a design flaw: the target moves at roughly the speed you approach it.

What changes the situation is deciding what enough is, in advance, on purpose.

This is unusual and slightly uncomfortable. Write down what a good life looks like for you specifically — the amount, the size, the standard. Not what would be ideal, but what you would honestly consider a life that worked. Most people have never done this, which means they are running a race with no finish line and are surprised to feel tired.

Then notice the difference between a real want and an inherited one. A lot of what people are chasing was never selected by them at all — it arrived from a neighbour, a cousin, a colleague, an advertisement, a wedding. The test is simple: if nobody would ever know you had it, would you still want it? Some things survive that question easily. Others collapse immediately, and those are the ones eating your years.

And break the comparison ladder. Every income level has a higher one visible from it, and each rung is populated by people who feel behind. This is why raising the amount never fixes the feeling. The only exit is deciding your own standard rather than accepting the one that the next rung up hands you.

One honest limit, since this can be preached badly. If you genuinely do not have enough — rent is uncertain, medical costs are looming, the family depends on an income that does not cover it — none of this applies, and being told to want less is an insult. Enough is a decision only above the line where needs are actually met. Below it, the correct response is not contentment. It is more money, and anyone who tells you otherwise is usually comfortable.
articles.contentHinglish:
Kisi se poochho ki kitna kaafi hoga, aur ek number milega. Phir kuch saal ruko jab tak wo number mil na jaaye, aur dobara poochho. Number aage khisak chuka hoga, aur wo khiskata rahega — kyunki mechanism number ke baare mein hai hi nahi.

Iska technical naam hedonic adaptation hai, aur baat itni si hai ki insaan har cheez ko normal bana leta hai. Jo bhi milta hai wo kuch mahino mein nayi baseline ban jaata hai — salary, ghar, phone, promotion. Pahunchne ki khushi asli hai, aur wo asthayi hai, aur reference point reset ho jaata hai. Phir jahan aap ho aur jo kaafi hota, unke beech ka faasla theek utna hi chauda hai jitna pehle tha.

Yeh cheezein chahne ke khilaf dalil nahi hai. Yeh is baat ki dalil hai ki "aur zyada paana" wali strategy mein akele ek design ki kharabi hai: target lagbhag usi raftaar se aage badhta hai jis raftaar se aap uske paas jaate ho.

Sthiti tab badalti hai jab aap pehle se, jaan bujh kar tay karte ho ki kaafi kya hai.

Yeh asaadharan hai aur thoda uncomfortable. Likh lo ki aapke liye theek theek achhi zindagi dikhti kaisi hai — kitna, kitni badi, kaunsa standard. Ideal kya hota wo nahi, balki wo jise aap imaandaari se aisi zindagi maanoge jo chal gayi. Zyadatar logon ne kabhi yeh kiya hi nahi, matlab wo ek aisi race daud rahe hain jiski finish line hai hi nahi, aur unhe hairani hai ki thakan kyun hai.

Phir asli chaah aur wirasat mein mili chaah mein farq dekho. Log jiske peechhe bhaag rahe hain uska bahut sara unhone chuna hi nahi — wo padosi se, cousin se, colleague se, kisi ad se, kisi shaadi se aaya. Test simple hai: agar kisi ko kabhi pata hi na chalta ki yeh aapke paas hai, tab bhi chahiye hota? Kuch cheezein yeh sawaal aaram se paar kar jaati hain. Kuch turant gir jaati hain, aur wahi aapke saal kha rahi hain.

Aur tulna ki seedhi todo. Har income level se upar ek aur level dikhta hai, aur har seedhi par wo log hain jinhe lagta hai wo peeche hain. Isiliye raqam badhane se feeling kabhi theek nahi hoti. Nikalne ka ek hi raasta hai — apna standard khud tay karna, bajaye us standard ko sweekar karne ke jo agli seedhi aapke haath mein thama deti hai.

Ek imaandaar limit, kyunki yeh baat bahut galat tareeke se sikhayi ja sakti hai. Agar aapke paas sach mein kaafi nahi hai — kiraya pakka nahi, ilaaj ka kharcha saamne khada hai, parivaar us aamdani par tika hai jo poori nahi padti — to yeh sab laagu nahi hota, aur "kam chaaho" sunna beizzati hai. "Kaafi" ek faisla sirf us line ke upar hai jahan zarooratein sach mein poori ho rahi hain. Uske neeche sahi jawab santosh nahi hai. Sahi jawab zyada paisa hai, aur jo ulta kehta hai wo aksar khud aaram mein hota hai.
